name: li-corporate-income-tax
description: Prepare 2026 Liechtenstein corporate income tax (Ertragssteuer) workpapers for ordinary legal entities under the Tax Act (SteG) and Tax Ordinance (SteV). Covers residence (seat or actual management), the 12.5% rate, the CHF 1,800 minimum tax and its CHF 500,000 balance-sheet exception, the book-to-tax bridge, the equity deduction on modified equity at the 4% Sollertrag with the 6% asset deduction and excess-liquidity rules, the participation exemption and its anti-abuse tests, loss use capped at 70%, the 12% source tax on nonresident board fees, electronic filing, extensions, provisional and final tax, 4% interest and fines. Trigger on: Liechtenstein corporate tax, Ertragssteuer, Eigenkapitalzinsabzug, Mindestertragssteuer, Liechtenstein GmbH tax return. Out of scope: PVS, groups, GloBE top-up tax, restructurings and special entities.
